title: WOML Compiled Workflow Model v10
description: Language-neutral DAG contract allowing an activated call-only workflow to declare zero source triggers.
x-invariants: An empty triggers array means call-only activation; it does not manufacture a manual or event trigger.
Workflow-call payload becomes the complete child context.trigger through engine-owned ingress metadata.
Module Runtime v1 remains optional and unchanged.
The graph remains a DAG with exactly the existing Script Bindings v1 and control-flow shapes.
Models v1-v9 remain immutable and executable under their original contracts.
